allOf.$comment: non-subform forms must declare either 'fields' or 'wizard' (or both)
subform forms must declare 'fields' and never 'wizard'

launchValidation.description: Check every launch of this form on the server: log what would be refused, or enforce (refuse, and run the extravars the server builds). The stricter of this and LAUNCH_VALIDATION wins.

enableForChat.description: Offer this form in the chat assistant (ENABLE_CHAT).

sameAs.description: The name of the field this one must match

items.$comment: Each wizard step references a subform. The summary step is appended automatically by the UI and must not be declared in YAML.
